title: Dev bug: NS profiles are overwritten with local profile
symptom: After setting up a local profile in AAPS, all previously stored NS profiles appear deleted; only a new 'LocalProfile' is visible in NS.
cause: AAPS always creates a new record with profiles in NS on update, which can overwrite or hide previous profiles.
fix: Enable/disable profile sync with NS; if advanced profiles are enabled in NS, you can revert to previous profiles because AAPS always creates a new record with profiles in NS on update. Old profiles can be found by selecting older database records in NS.
evidence_quote: you can allow/disable profile sync with NS. If you have enabled advanced profiles (in NS) you can always revert to previous profiles because AAPS always creates new record with profiles in NS on update
